html:
1What You Will Learn

Note

Acronyms in this note. RDS: Relational Database Service; MFA: multi-factor authentication; SQS: Simple Queue Service; SNS: Simple Notification Service; EC2: Elastic Compute Cloud

  • Pace the 65 questions in 90 minutes with checkpoints
  • Use a four-step method: read, predict, eliminate, confirm
  • Handle multiple-response questions, qualifier words and look-alike traps
  • Plan your final week, exam day and, if needed, a retake

2Reading, answering and shortcuts

Running case

Tidewater's Mock Exam

  • Tidewater's founder sat a practice exam and finished just under the pass mark
  • The review showed lost points, not lost knowledge: misread questions, look-alike services and blank answers
  • The course content is covered; now technique has to match it
  • Your job: turn what you know into points

The Exam Clock Beyond the guide

  • 65 questions in 90 minutes is about 83 seconds each
  • Aim for about 70 seconds on a first pass; the spare time is for the hard questions
  • Use checkpoints as the latest you should reach: question 20 by minute 28, 40 by 55, 65 by 85
  • 15 questions are unscored and you cannot tell which, so treat every one as real

Exam tip

If you are behind at a checkpoint, answer quickly and move on; a blank always scores zero.

Read for the Requirement Beyond the guide

  • Read the last line first: it holds what is being asked (a tip from AWS's own certification blog)
  • Then read the scenario and underline the requirement words: most cost-effective, least operational overhead, highly available, most secure
  • Note the verb: record, block, detect, scan, encrypt, estimate, warn
  • Note the subject: you or AWS, a Region or an edge location
  • Predict the answer before you look at the options
Exam tip

The scenario is the story; the last line is the test.

A Four-Step Answer Method Beyond the guide

  • Read: the last line first, then the scenario
  • Predict: name the service or idea before you see the options
  • Eliminate: remove the options that are clearly wrong
  • Confirm: match the requirement word and the verb to what is left

Exam tip

A prediction stops a plausible distractor from pulling you off course.

Eliminating Distractors Beyond the guide

  • Distractors are real services that sound plausible, so ask why each one fails
  • Wrong job: it does something else (Inspector scans; GuardDuty detects)
  • Wrong size: too much access, setup or cost for the need
  • Wrong model: you manage what AWS should, or the reverse
  • Half true: one clause fits and another does not
  • Words such as always and never deserve a second look
Exam tip

Remove two of four options and a guess is right half the time.

Multiple-Response Questions Beyond the guide

  • A multiple-response question has two or more correct answers among five or more options
  • The question tells you how many to choose, such as Select TWO
  • Judge each option on its own, true or false against the question, then count
  • Choose exactly the number asked
  • The exam guide does not say how these are marked, so aim for every correct option
Exam tip

If three options fit, reread the question for the word that rules one out.

Qualifier Words Steer the Answer Beyond the guide

If the question says… Think…
Most cost-effective The cheapest option that still meets the need: Spot for interruptible work, Savings Plans for steady use, cooler S3 classes for rare access
Least operational overhead Managed or serverless: RDS, Lambda, Fargate
Highly available More than one Availability Zone, with a load balancer and Auto Scaling
Lowest latency worldwide CloudFront and edge locations
Most secure, least privilege The narrowest permissions; roles, not shared keys; MFA
Quickly, on demand On-Demand pricing and Auto Scaling
Decouple, buffer, fan out SQS, SNS and EventBridge
Exam tip

Underline the qualifier: it is the word that picks one correct answer from several that work.

Responsibility Shortcuts

  • AWS: security of the cloud: the hardware, software, networking and facilities that run AWS services
  • You: security in the cloud: your data, who can access it, and how you configure services
  • Managed services shift more to AWS: Lambda and RDS leave less to you than EC2
  • Shared controls: patching, configuration, and awareness and training, each owned on its own side
  • Inherited controls: you receive them from AWS, such as physical security
Exam tip

Ask who can see and configure the thing. If only AWS can, it is AWS's job.

Cost Question Shortcuts

The need Think…
Steady, predictable use Savings Plans or Reserved Instances
Flexible work that can be interrupted Spot Instances
Short or unpredictable use On-Demand
Your own licenses, or dedicated hardware Dedicated Hosts
Guaranteed capacity On-Demand Capacity Reservations
Estimate, analyze, warn Pricing Calculator, Cost Explorer, Budgets
Many accounts, one bill AWS Organizations with consolidated billing
Data transfer In is free; out and across Regions cost money
Exam tip

Cost questions are pattern matching: name the need first, then the option.

3Staying calm, preparation and practice

When You Are Unsure Beyond the guide

  • Never leave a question blank: an unanswered question counts as wrong, and a guess has no penalty
  • Eliminate first, then choose between what is left
  • When two answers fit, prefer the one that is managed, least privilege and simplest
  • Take the plain reading of the question, not a clever one
  • Change an answer only when you find a specific reason
  • If the screen lets you mark a question to revisit, use it for hard ones, and check the exam tutorial
Exam tip

A blank always scores zero; a guess might not.

Your Final Week Beyond the guide

When Do this
Seven days out Read the current exam guide again and check for changes
Six to four days out Redo the questions for your two weakest domains; write your own look-alike notes
Three days out Take a timed run of about 65 questions in 90 minutes; AWS offers free 20-question practice sets
Two days out Read module 15 once, then say the lists aloud
The day before A light review, a good night's sleep and your exam-day logistics
Exam tip

Practice under the clock: pace is a skill, and it improves with repetition.

Exam Day and Afterwards [Verify live]

  • Delivery: at a Pearson VUE test center or online with a proctor; read the provider's rules for ID, room and check-in
  • Fee: USD 100; a pass is valid for 3 years
  • Results: posted to your AWS Certification Account within five business days after the exam, unless held for review
  • If you do not pass: wait 14 calendar days; there is no limit on attempts and each one needs the full fee
  • If you pass: you cannot retake the same exam for two years
  • As of 4 November 2026: AWS may change fees and policies, so read its pages before you book
Exam tip

Policies and fees change; check AWS's certification pages before you book.

Design Check: Tidewater's Mock Exam

What went wrong Technique to apply
Ran short of time in the last ten questions Checkpoints: question 20 by minute 28, 40 by minute 55
Chose Inspector for "detect stolen credentials" Read the verb: detecting threats is GuardDuty
Picked one answer in a "Select TWO" question Judge each option and choose exactly two
Chose the dearest option for "most cost-effective" Match the pricing option to the usage pattern
Left three questions blank Answer every one: there is no penalty
Mixed up AWS's duty and its own Ask who can see and configure it
  • Cover the right column, answer each row yourself, then compare

4Exam Q&A

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer; some ask for two)

S1Tidewater needs a relational database for its order system, with the least operational overhead, and the team has no database administrators. Which option fits best?

  • AAmazon EC2, with the team installing and patching a database engine
  • BAmazon RDS, a managed relational database service
  • CAmazon S3, which stores objects rather than relational tables
  • DAmazon ElastiCache, an in-memory cache rather than a primary store
Show the answer

Answer: B. The requirement words are relational and least operational overhead. RDS is a managed relational database, so AWS handles most of the administration. EC2 leaves the patching to Tidewater, S3 is object storage, and ElastiCache is a cache.

S2Tidewater's security lead needs to find out which user deleted a security group last night. Which service records who made that API call?

  • AAWS CloudTrail, which records API calls and who made them
  • BAmazon CloudWatch, which collects metrics and logs and raises alarms
  • CAWS Config, which records resource settings and changes over time
  • DAmazon GuardDuty, which detects threats from logs and network activity
Show the answer

Answer: A. The verb is who. CloudTrail records API activity, including the identity of the caller. CloudWatch shows how healthy a resource is, Config shows what changed, and GuardDuty detects threats.

S3Tidewater's order system runs on Amazon EC2 around the clock, with steady usage that must not be interrupted. Which TWO purchasing options can lower the cost compared with On-Demand pricing? (Select TWO.)

  • ASpot Instances, which use spare capacity and can be interrupted
  • BSavings Plans, which commit to a steady dollar amount per hour
  • CDedicated Instances, which run on single-tenant hardware
  • DReserved Instances, which commit to a configuration for a term
  • ECapacity Reservations used on their own, to hold capacity
Show the answer

Answer: B, D. Steady usage that must not be interrupted suits a commitment: Savings Plans or Reserved Instances. Spot can be interrupted, Dedicated Instances cost more for isolation, and a Capacity Reservation on its own holds capacity without a discount.

S4Tidewater stores customer data in Amazon RDS. Which task is still Tidewater's responsibility under the shared responsibility model?

  • AReplacing failed storage hardware in the data center
  • BKeeping the facility physically secure
  • CDeciding which users and applications can read the data
  • DPatching the operating system of the database server
Show the answer

Answer: C. Customers are responsible for their data and for who can access it. AWS looks after the hardware, the facilities and, with a managed service such as RDS, the operating system of the database server.

S5With six minutes left, Tidewater's founder has four questions unanswered and is unsure of each. Based on the exam guide's scoring rules, what should they do?

  • ALeave all four blank, because wrong answers reduce the score
  • BAnswer only the two that feel most likely, and leave two blank
  • CSpend the remaining time rechecking earlier answers instead
  • DAnswer all four, because a blank counts as wrong and a guess has no penalty
Show the answer

Answer: D. The exam guide says an unanswered question counts as incorrect and there is no penalty for guessing. A guess can only help; a blank always scores zero.

5Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Pace 65 questions, 90 minutes, about 83 seconds each, with checkpoints
Method read the last line, predict, eliminate, confirm
Traps look-alike services, qualifier words and absolute words
Multiple response judge each option; choose exactly the number asked
Unsure never leave a blank; there is no penalty for guessing
Plan a final week, exam day and, if needed, a retake after 14 days
